release_notes.en: Critical fixes: in-app updater now actually finds new releases (host allow-list); config saves under LocalAppData (no more Permission denied); Self-Healing no longer false-flags healthy core installs; bootstrap.log captures pip output.
release_notes.tr: Kritik duzeltmeler: in-app guncelleyici artik yeni surumleri buluyor (host allow-list); config kullanici dizininde (Permission denied yok); Self-Healing saglikli core kurulumlari hatali isaretlemiyor; bootstrap.log pip ciktisini yakaliyor.
